title: The fastest-spinning pulsar rotates over 700 times per second.
narration: Did you know the fastest-spinning pulsar rotates over 700 times per second? That's more than seven hundred spins in the time it takes you to blink! This extreme speed makes it one of the most fascinating objects in the universe.
